value.value: DSC heating shows an endotherm at 115–130 °C assigned to melting; cooling gives an exotherm at 110–90 °C. A lower feature near 66 °C is assigned to surface rearrangement. Three 35–75 °C cycles do not remove the higher-temperature endotherm.
